notes: CDER CGMP letter for a sterile/aseptic OTC drug manufacturer: recurring media fill failures, poor aseptic technique in ISO 5 areas, inadequate airflow visualization studies, and undefined EM worst-case locations, leading to a recall for 'lack of sterility assurance' (21 CFR 211.113(b) etc.). The finished-product names are redacted as (b)(4); 'Naphazoline HCl (NPZ)' is named once but only as an active ingredient inside a still-redacted formulation, not as the product name itself, so it is omitted from products.
